verdict.rationale: Riskified is a SaaS fraud-prevention platform, so an official MCP server is a plausible offering and the axis applies. The evidence shows only a REST API, language SDKs, webhooks-style notifications and an llms.txt docs file. None of these is an MCP server: llms.txt and the REST/SDK surfaces are adjacent building blocks, not a first-party MCP endpoint an agent can connect to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
